summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Red Pot Kitchen birria sliders website. Verified all core layout requirements, navigation functionality, product displays, and responsive design. Found minor navigation underline indicator issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigation underline indicator not switching properly between sections - About link underline shows 0px width when active
ui_bugs.details: Active section detection may not be working correctly for About section

passed_tests: Navigation displays RED POT logo in correct red color (#E44720)
Navigation has Order and About links only (no Home link found)
Cart icon visible and accessible in navigation
Hero section displays BIRRIA BOMB title with underline animation
Hero video fallback displays 'RED POT' text (codec issues as expected)
SOLO product displays with 'SOLO' background text overlapping image
DOUBLE product displays with 'DOUBLE' background text overlapping image
Desktop layout correct: BUY NOW button LEFT, product image CENTER, info RIGHT
Price positioned above product name (correct order)
Gold underlines display under product names
BUY NOW buttons open modal with correct product information
Modal closes properly with Escape key
Modal displays correct product titles (Order SOLO BOMB / Order DOUBLE BOMB)
Mobile responsive navigation with hamburger menu functionality
Mobile layout follows correct order: Image → Name → Description → Price → BUY NOW
Mobile BUY NOW buttons work for both products
About section displays complete brand story content
Footer displays copyright with current year (2026)
Background text overlaps product images and is visible (not low opacity)
Product pricing displays correctly (₱65 for SOLO, ₱100 for DOUBLE)
Page animations work (fade in, scale effects)
Brand colors match specification (background #141311, red #E44720, gold #EAC783)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix navigation underline indicator - About section active state detection not working properly. The underline should show full width when About section is active.
